items.item_text: Radiation Safety certification and Coronal Polish certification.
Active/valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross (includes hands-on simulated clinical scenarios).
Minimum 3 years of experience serving as Dental Assistant, including experience assisting a Dentist and Dental Hygienist.

Venice Family Clinic is a leader in providing comprehensive, high-quality health care to people in need regardless of their ability to pay or personal circumstance. The organization has more than 500 staff who serve 45,000 people with compassion, dignity and respect across the Westside of Los Angeles, Inglewood, the South Bay and everywhere in between. We have a network of clinics, Early Head Start centers, and mobile clinics plus an expansive street medicine program to reach people experiencing homelessness. Read more about us at venicefamilyclinic.org.

Utilize your knowledge and skills to make a difference in the communities that we serve as a Dental Assistant. With guidance from the Senior Dentist, the Dental Assistant will perform dental assisting for Venice Family Clinic's Dental Program. Key duties include the coordination of patient flow, providing dental assistance to dentists and dental hygienists with chair side supportive procedures as approved by the dental board, disinfecting/sterilization of equipment and instruments, compliance with infection control policies, and taking/developing radiographs as prescribed by the dentist.
Note this is a full-time limited position for 5.5 months that may convert to career.
California Dental Board-approved course in the California Dental Practice Act, an 8-hour California Dental Board-approved course in infection control.
Bilingual verbal skills in English and Spanish.
Working knowledge of current dental terminology, materials, equipment, and procedures related to dentistry.
Working knowledge of principles of asepsis, sterilization procedures, and infection control.
Ability to organize and maintain an inventory of dental instruments, equipment, and supplies in the dental operatory.
Ability to handle multiple demands and frequent interruptions while maintaining a professional demeanor.
Ability to work with infectious disease patients.
Skill in understanding both written and oral instructions.
Must have working knowledge of dental software and Microsoft Office, and ability to record patient information for charting and reporting purposes.
